beschreibung:
Our 2 Cents Vol. 38 brings a full lineup of Booski stories about boundaries, friendships, family entitlement, social media expectations, cheating, and the complicated space between support and disrespect. Nesha G and Moelethal respond to situations where people are trying to figure out what is fair, what is messy, and what needs to be addressed before resentment takes over.
In this episode, we discuss a mother-in-law treating a summer apartment like it belongs to her, a picky boyfriend refusing frozen food and leftovers, and a woman wondering if her boyfriend should have posted her for her 30th birthday. Nesha and Moe also react to a godmother acting strangely about seeing pictures on a phone, a friend using an inside joke to torment a cheating woman, and a follow-up from the woman involved with her abusive ex-husband’s best friend.
The episode also asks whether opposite-sex friendships can work in marriage. Through every story, the answer keeps coming back to boundaries, communication, respect, and whether everyone involved understands the role they are supposed to play.
